finding: A rank-matched tree arm can be drawn from isomorphism classes instead of seeds at every size from 7 to 11. The star is alone at its rank at all five sizes, which is why a tree null cannot separate rank from star-ness however many trees are drawn: the comparison has to hold rank fixed and vary the shape, not the other way round. The deepest rank-matched sets and their edge lists are in this receipt, with the maximum-degree range of each set, so an arm can be chosen to span hub structure at fixed rank.
scope: Graph structure only. Rank is the bipartite imbalance plus one, which holds for a connected bipartite spin-1/2 antiferromagnet with no intra-sublattice bond and is checked against the four K_{a,b} values in his sweep. Nothing here computes C or the learned TAT, and nothing here is evidence about either.
